_comment: Uniform-FR campaign, ethane/ZIF-8 stage -- the campaign's FIRST FLEXIBLE-FRAMEWORK system. Frozen BEFORE any reference, screen, calibration or production run. TWO ARMS ONLY (abf, fr_uniform): no sham, no oracle, no estimated target, per standing user directive -- in a real molecular application nobody knows the reaction coordinate's landscape, so the uniform target is the only deployable one.
_why_this_system: ZIF-8's 6MR window (3.4 A) is narrower than ethane, and passage is enabled by thermal linker motion: the framework gate is a PHYSICAL hidden slow coordinate. The stage therefore separates three clocks the campaign's predictor needs kept apart -- discovery (T_cover) != marginal establishment (T_marg) != conditional gate equilibration (T_gate). Marginal FR can only repair the middle one; the closed R15 pentane result says it cannot repair the third. This is the first system in the project where that distinction is measurable on real physics rather than a constructed toy.

_provenance.structure: cache/zif8/literature/zif8_raspa2_github.cif -- P1 conventional cell (276 atoms, a = 16.991 A) from Park et al., PNAS 2006, 103, 10186 (CSD FAWCEN), via numat/RASPA2.
_provenance.force_field: cache/zif8/literature/zif8_gromacs_aanik_atomtypes_ZIF-8_Krokidas.itp -- the KROKIDAS et al. (JPCC 2015, 119, 27028) flexible ZIF-8 force field, i.e. the force field OF THE ANCHOR PAPER (Schmidt, Cnudde, Van Speybroeck, Vanduyfhuys, JPCC 2024, 128, 18509), in the Anikeenko 2017 GROMACS adaptation.
_provenance.topology_validation: scripts/build_zif8_framework.py enumerates bonds/angles/dihedrals/1-4 pairs from CONNECTIVITY and asserts SET EQUALITY against the published 2x2x2 GROMACS topology: 2496 bonds, 4608 angles, 7296 propers, 6336 pairs -- all identical, and every published term resolves to the same parameter type. Composition Zn12 N48 C1_24 C2_48 C3_24 H2_48 H3_72, coordination and charge neutrality all asserted.
declared_deviations: Electrostatics are damped-shifted-force (Fennell-Gezelter, alpha = 0.2 1/A) rather than Ewald; the model is DEFINED with DSF, it is not an approximation to something else. Cutoff rc = 0.49*a, the largest value the minimum-image convention permits in the 1x1x1 cell.
The rigid TraPPE-UA ethane bond is replaced by the repo's harmonic convention (k = 400 kJ/mol/A^2, r0 = 1.54 A); bond-length fluctuation sqrt(kT/k) ~ 0.08 A.
Host-guest LJ by Lorentz-Berthelot between TraPPE-UA CH3 (eps/kB 98 K, sigma 3.75 A) and the Krokidas framework types.

The CIF's ordered methyl rotamers are not body-centred (max 0.79 A on H3 only; every other atom type is exact). The methyl is a FREE ROTOR in this force field (all H3-C3-C1-N torsions have k = 0), so F(phi) is exactly periodic by symmetry and only the INSTANTANEOUS potential is not -- measured at ~0.001 kT.

Production uses the 1x1x1 conventional cell (276 atoms, 2 cages). The anchor paper used 2x2x2 for its force-field runs. This is a declared finite-size choice made for compute; the periodic images of the studied gate are correlated with it.

system.guest: one TraPPE-UA ethane at infinite dilution (no guest-guest physics this round)
system.cell:
1x1x1 conventional cubic, lattice constant set by Stage 0A (

= 1 bar from the atomic virial), NOT tuned to reproduce any literature barrier
system.cv: phi = wrap(2 pi xi / L), xi = (COM_ethane - win_center) . n, where win_center is the centroid of the 6 Zn of the gate and n its plane normal -- the SAME collective variable the anchor paper defines. L = |(a/2)(1,1,1)| is a LATTICE TRANSLATION, so xi is exactly periodic: the channel needs no axial walls, and cage -> window -> cage repeats. Evaluated on UNWRAPPED guest coordinates (the tube is longer than the minimum-image cube; a min-imaged CV would be wrong by up to 4.9 A -- measured).
system.confinement: radial flat-bottom tube of radius R_tube about the gate axis on the guest COM (k = 100 kJ/mol/A^2). Measured: captures 98.9% of the guest-accessible cage volume, and every OTHER window out of the cage lies >1.5 A outside it. Identical in both arms AND in the reference.
system.hidden_gate: DIAGNOSTIC ONLY, never biased, never seen by FR. A_gate = mean radial distance of the six bottleneck ring-H from the instantaneous Zn6 centroid (the 6-ring alternates: three linkers present their ring C-H edge, three their methyl); theta_gate = mean linker-plane tilt. A_gate is the same 6MR gate radius the anchor paper reports.

sampler._note: fr_start = warmup end = estimator burn-in end (the LTA sweep lesson: starting FR after establishment has already happened erases the entire opportunity). Identical force-evaluation budget in every arm. dt and n_steps are the ONE pair of values the protocol allows to be revised, once each, from the recorded Stage-0C and screen outputs, BEFORE any FR run; the revision and its justification are appended to _resolved below.

reference_rule.method: umbrella sampling on the circular CV + periodic WHAM, one independent BAOAB run per window
reference_rule.acceptance: split-half barrier within 0.3 kT; split-half profile RMS within 0.3 kT; adjacent-window overlap (circularly closed) >= 2 bins; AND the reference's own hidden-gate conditional at the window must be split-half converged (JS < 0.02) -- the reference is not accepted merely because WHAM returns a smooth curve, and it is not usable as the T_gate yardstick unless its OWN gate conditional has converged.
reference_rule.records: F(xi), U(xi), U_hostguest(xi), -T dS = F - U, p(xi), and p_ref(A_gate | |xi| < gate_band_A)

screen.protocol: ABF-ONLY, one run, 8 seed labels batched, the production sampler above. No FR arm exists at this stage; the classification alone licenses or refuses the two-arm run.
screen.T_cover: first save at which EVERY grid bin has been visited, sustained for cover_hold_frac*T
screen.T_marg: with J(t) = TV(p_t^xi, uniform), J_inf = median over the last 20% of the run and J_0 the first post-warmup value: first t with J(t) <= J_inf + 0.2 (J_0 - J_inf), sustained for 0.1 T. RELATIVE, not the CHA stage's absolute TV < 0.10 -- that threshold was beta-naive and needed an amendment, because a plateau set by O(1 kJ/mol) estimator residuals is not a failure to establish.
screen.T_gate: the same relative rule applied to J_gate(t) = JS( p_t(A_gate | |xi| < gate_band_A) || p_ref(A_gate | same band) ), with p_ref from the accepted umbrella reference.

classifier.discovery_limited: T_cover > 0.5 T or any bin never visited
classifier.conditional_limited: T_gate > 0.5 T while xi has coverage
classifier.establishment_limited: T_cover < 0.25 T and 0.25 T <= T_marg <= 0.8 T and T_gate < 0.25 T
classifier.otherwise: intermediate -- reported, not forced into a box

screen._licensing_note: establishment_limited is the main FR candidate; abf_sufficient is kept as the neutrality control; intermediate is licensed with its screen facts recorded as the per-cell prediction before unblinding (the CHA A1 amendment, adopted here from the start rather than after the fact). conditional_limited is ALSO licensed and is the scientifically most interesting outcome -- it is the R15 failure mode on real physics, and refusing to run it would leave the campaign's central negative prediction untested; the prediction 'marginal FR cannot repair it' is recorded HERE, before the data. discovery_limited gets NO FR run and NO rescue claim.

fr_rate_rule.rule: largest rate satisfying min ancestor ESS/N >= 0.30 AND max lineage share <= 0.05 AND event fraction <= max_event_fraction, over the FR-active saves, chosen WITHOUT reading any error metric and without loading the reference.
fr_rate_rule._horizon_note: The ladder runs the FULL production horizon. The olefin/CHA stage calibrated at 150k steps, selected rate 0.10, and then production at 400k steps landed at ESS/N = 0.221 -- below the 0.30 floor its own calibration had certified. Ancestor collapse accumulates with the number of birth-death events, i.e. with the HORIZON, so a short ladder systematically over-certifies. run_zif8_uniform.py asserts the calibration horizon equals the production horizon.

production.pairing: both arms in ONE process, sharing the init pool draw and the dynamics RNG stream; the FR stream is independent so that fr_rate = 0 reproduces ABF bit-for-bit (asserted in tests/test_zif8.py)

endpoints.primary: I_F = integral of e_F(t) dt over the saved horizon, where e_F is the gauge-ALIGNED RMS of F_hat - F_ref over the full circular domain (the whole channel is the scoring region: the CV is periodic and there is no wall, so there is no mask to choose and no place to hide a gain outside one). Statistic: per-seed paired Delta I_F = 100 (I_F^uni / I_F^abf - 1), median over 16 seeds, 10000-resample bootstrap CI of the median (seed 20260829).
endpoints.final: e_F(T), always reported (transient vs persistent acceleration must be visible -- the gateway EMA arm's late reversal is why this cannot be hidden)
endpoints.mean_force: e_F'(t), the NON-aligned RMS of F_hat' - F_ref' (the mean force has no gauge freedom)
endpoints.time_to_accuracy: tau_eps, first t with e_F <= eps sustained for 0.2 T, eps in {e0/2, e0/4, e0/8, abf_final}; censoring reported, never imputed
endpoints.genealogy: ancestor ESS/N, unique-ancestor count, max lineage share, cumulative replacement events
endpoints.hidden_gate: J_gate(t) per arm against the umbrella reference; the cumulative A_gate distribution at the window per arm vs the reference; and A_gate at the instant of every completed cage-to-cage transit -- this is what distinguishes 'FR created independent open-gate opportunities' from 'FR multiplied correlated copies of one gate state'.
endpoints.figures: the three-panel aligned mechanism figure (marginal -> mean force -> free energy) with t_FR marked, plus the gate, genealogy, speedup and reference panels (scripts/plot_uniform_zif8.py)

verdicts.SAFE_ACCELERATOR: median dI_F <= -10%, CI95 upper < 0, final within +5%, genealogy floors met
verdicts.ACCELERATION_POSITIVE_BUT_UNSAFE: the accuracy gate is met but a genealogy floor or the final non-inferiority margin is violated
verdicts.HARMFUL: median dI_F >= +10% OR CI95 lower > 0 (the FR arm is worse, significantly)
verdicts.NEUTRAL: TOST equivalence -- the WHOLE CI95 lies inside +-10% -- with the genealogy floors met and the final margin held
verdicts.INCONCLUSIVE: anything else, e.g. a CI too wide to place the effect

predictions_recorded_before_data: The barrier will be substantially entropic (the anchor paper decomposes it as such, with favourable host-guest and unfavourable host-deformation contributions cancelling). Per the closed LTA sweep, the entropic fraction is NOT the predictor of FR benefit and will not be used as one.
The predictor being tested is marginal establishment STARVATION, the LTA sweep's surviving verdict.

If the screen returns conditional_limited (T_gate >> T_marg), the prediction is that uniform marginal FR is NEUTRAL-to-harmful on I_F, because cloning on xi alone multiplies descendants of the same gate configuration -- the R15 pentane failure mode. The falsifiable signature is J_gate worse in the FR arm than in the ABF arm at matched compute, which analyze_uniform_zif8.py computes and reports as gate.fr_gate_worse_than_abf.
gpu_policy: GPU 3 only (H200), per standing user instruction; multiple processes on that one device are allowed.
prohibited: tuning any FR knob on an error metric
adding arms, targets, cells or seed extensions after data are seen
claiming FR rescue on a discovery-limited cell
choosing the temperature or the horizon after seeing any FR result
tuning the lattice constant to make the barrier resemble the literature value
editing this file after the first production run starts

_resolved._note: Values determined by the recorded Stage-0 outputs BEFORE any FR run, with their evidence. Nothing here may be set after an FR result is seen.
_resolved.lattice_evidence:
Stage 0A virial scan:

(a) = +3129, +100, -2826, -4834, -6410, -8244 bar at a = 16.30, 16.50, 16.70, 16.85, 16.991, 17.15 A ->

= 1 bar at a = 16.507 A. Corroborated externally: the anchor paper's own Krokidas-FF supercell is 33.19 A, i.e. a = 16.595 A, from a real barostat -- 0.5% agreement by an independent route. Not tuned to any barrier.
_resolved.dt_evidence: Stage 0C compared the binned local mean force at dt = 0.001 and 0.002 ps against dt = 0.0005: RMS differences 1.363 and 1.225 kJ/mol/rad. dt = 0.002 deviating LESS than dt = 0.001 shows the comparison was dominated by sampling noise, not timestep bias, so the gate was INCONCLUSIVE and did not license a larger dt. The conservative 0.5 fs is kept -- it is also the anchor paper's timestep, and the C-H period is 11.3 fs (22 steps). Gate statistics were dt-independent: A_gate 2.7952/2.7953/2.7953 A with identical sd.
_resolved.precision_evidence: Stage 0C: the f32 force kernel's BIAS in the local mean force -- the quantity ABF integrates -- is +4.5e-6 +- 1.3e-6 kJ/mol/rad against |f_loc| ~ 9.4, i.e. 4.7e-7 relative; total energy agrees to 0.0028 kJ/mol = 0.001 kT. Measured speedup 2.54x (5348 -> 13585 ns/day aggregate at B = 512). Positions/accumulators stay f64.
_resolved.horizon_evidence: Chosen on COMPUTE, before any FR run: 2 arms x 16 seeds x 384 replicas x 300 ps = 3686 ns aggregate ~ 6.3 h at the measured 14100 ns/day. 384 replicas over 96 grid bins is 4 walkers/bin for the FR score's KDE. The ABF-only screen runs at the SAME horizon, so its three clocks are measured on the budget production will actually have.
_resolved.determinism_evidence: torch.use_deterministic_algorithms + torch._inductor.config.deterministic are set at import in src/zif8/core_zif8.py. Measured on the H200 (forces repeated on identical input, B=512): compiled f32 default 6.1e-05, compiled f64 default 1.1e-13, eager 0 but 8.8x slower, compiled f32 + flags 0 and still 1.47x faster than f64. WITHOUT this the two arms diverge from the first step and the paired endpoint silently becomes unpaired -- which is what happened to the WCA stage. Cost 1.75x, paid deliberately. Regression-tested by tests/test_zif8.py::test_gpu_arms_are_exactly_paired, which asserts the arms are BIT-IDENTICAL for all 60000 steps before fr_start.
_resolved.estimator_binning: The ABF accumulators use a deterministic one-hot scatter_ + fixed-order sum instead of scatter_add_ (CUDA float atomics), since the accumulators feed the bias and therefore the trajectory. Cost R*N*G, negligible beside the force kernel.

engine._note: Positions, velocities, the CV and every estimator accumulator are f64; ONLY the force/energy kernel runs f32. Full-f32 positions would not be safe -- the guest's unwrapped axial coordinate drifts to O(100 A) while one step moves it 2.5e-4 A.
engine._determinism_note: torch.use_deterministic_algorithms + torch._inductor.config.deterministic are set at import in src/zif8/core_zif8.py. Measured on the H200 (forces repeated on identical input, B=512): compiled f32 default 6.1e-05, compiled f64 default 1.1e-13, eager 0 but 8.8x slower, compiled f32 + flags 0 and still 1.47x faster than f64. WITHOUT this the two arms diverge from the first step and the paired endpoint silently becomes unpaired -- which is what happened to the WCA stage. Cost 1.75x, paid deliberately. Regression-tested by tests/test_zif8.py::test_gpu_arms_are_exactly_paired, which asserts the arms are BIT-IDENTICAL for all 60000 steps before fr_start.

_amendments.when: BEFORE any FR run and before any production data on this system. The umbrella reference had begun and was KILLED 40 min in; it is being re-run under these rules. No arm, target, cell or seed is added or removed and no FR knob is touched.
_amendments.why: An adversarial audit of the new analysis/classification code (against this project's own recorded defect classes) found defects that would have corrupted the conclusion rather than raised an error.
changes: SCREEN CLASSIFIER. np.isfinite(inf) is False, so a gate that NEVER equilibrates (T_gate = inf) failed the conditional_limited test and then satisfied the abf_sufficient guard, which read 'not isfinite' as evidence of health. The strongest possible conditional-limitation signal was routed into the NEUTRALITY CONTROL, and the frozen rule text ('T_gate > 0.5T', which inf satisfies) was contradicted by its own implementation. A missing reference (nan) took the same path. Fixed; a missing reference now yields the explicit verdict 'unclassified_no_gate_reference'.

T_marg / T_gate THRESHOLD. J_0 was read at t = 0 although the frozen text says 'the first POST-WARMUP value'. The pre-warmup value is always the largest, so the threshold was inflated and both clocks biased SHORT -- systematically away from establishment_limited, the verdict this campaign is hunting. Measured on a plausible TV curve: T_marg 33 ps (0.11 T, -> abf_sufficient) as coded vs 148 ps (0.49 T, -> establishment_limited) as written. The code now matches the frozen text.

DEGRADING CURVES. When a curve gets WORSE (J_inf > J0) the relative threshold falls BETWEEN J0 and J_inf and was met at i = 0, reporting 'equilibrated at t = 0' for a diverging gate. Now returned as inf with status 'degrading'.

PERSISTENCE WINDOWS. Both relative_time and tau let the sustain window truncate at the tail, making the criterion easiest exactly where the evidence is weakest -- one noisy final sample could move the cell between the two extreme verdicts, and a single final save below eps reported a tau with zero persistence. The window must now fit inside the data; otherwise the value is censored, as the frozen endpoint text requires ('censoring reported, never imputed').

J_gate IS NOW A CONDITIONAL, RESOLVED IN xi. p(A_gate | |xi| < band) is a MIXTURE whose weights are each ensemble's own p(xi | band) -- and FR deliberately flattens that marginal. Demonstrated: with p(A_gate|xi) held identical, a pure marginal reshuffle inside the band produced JS 0.0006-0.019, the same order as a genuine 0.25-0.5 sd gate displacement (0.006-0.023). The stage's declared falsifiable signature could therefore have fired, or been falsely refuted, for a purely marginal reason -- and T_marg and T_gate were not the independent clocks the design claims. The gate histogram is now recorded as (n_gate_xi = 8) x (n_gate_bins), and J_gate is the mean over xi sub-bins of the per-sub-bin JS, which divides the marginal out.

GATE HISTOGRAM RESOLUTION. The [2.0, 4.5]/40-bin grid gave 0.0625 A bins = 1.08 sd of the Stage-0B aperture law, with only ~5 bins carrying mass -- too coarse for the stage's central diagnostic. Now [2.2, 4.6]/96 bins = 0.025 A = 0.43 sd. Out-of-range samples are DROPPED (matching the reference's np.histogram) instead of clamped into the edge bin, and the dropped count is recorded so it can never be silently zero.

accept_gate_js 0.02 -> 0.001. At the frozen umbrella budget a split-half of the same law scores ~2e-6, so 0.02 passed by four orders of magnitude: a gate that could not fire. It is the gate that licenses the reference as the T_gate yardstick.

TRANSIT COUNTING. `crossings` is a cumulative per-walker count, not state, and was inherited on a clone -- re-counting the parent's completed transits once per clone. The uniform target clones window walkers preferentially, so the population total drifted UPWARD in the FR arm ONLY (4-8% at production scale in a bookkeeping replay). A clone now starts from zero, and the analysis counts transits from the per-event list instead.

VERDICT TREE. The old tree let an FR arm 9.9% WORSE with a CI excluding zero report NEUTRAL, let an arm in genealogical collapse report NEUTRAL (health gated only the 'safe' label), and labelled a 12%-BETTER arm NEGATIVE_OR_UNSAFE because its CI straddled zero. NEUTRAL is now TOST equivalence (the whole CI inside +-10%) with the health floors required, HARMFUL is explicit, and INCONCLUSIVE absorbs the rest.

REFERENCE INTEGRITY. The reference npz was written BEFORE its acceptance gates were asserted, so a rejected reference was left on disk looking usable, and no consumer read the stored acceptance. It is now written only after the gates pass, carries `accepted`, and unsampled WHAM bins are NaN-masked rather than left as the finite +1718 kJ/mol that -log(1e-300)/beta produces.

BARRIER DEFINITION. barrier() used unpreregistered half-widths and returns a window-MEAN minus cage-MEAN, which was printed against the anchor paper's PEAK-minus-minimum 24.2 kJ/mol -- two different quantities. The widths are now preregistered (0.6/1.5 A) and the peak-based value is computed and reported alongside as the comparable one.

DECLARED SECONDARY ENDPOINT. The arms are bit-identical before fr_start (regression-tested), so that segment contributes exactly zero to the difference while carrying ~21-24% of I_F, diluting the frozen -10% threshold. The frozen primary is UNCHANGED (full-horizon, campaign convention); dI_F restricted to t >= fr_start is now computed and reported beside it, with the pre-FR share of I_F stated, so the dilution is visible rather than absorbed.

CALIBRATION POPULATION. fr_rate_rule.n_replicas raised 256 -> 384 to match production; 2.67 vs 4.00 walkers per grid bin changes the FR score's KDE noise and hence the event rate the safety ladder certifies.
COVERAGE CLAUSE. cover_hold_frac was a no-op (n_visited_bins is monotone, so 'sustained' is implied). Removed rather than left as a rule that cannot bite.
_amendments.not_changed: The frozen primary endpoint, the -10% / CI-upper<0 success thresholds, the arms, the target, the cell, the seeds, the FR rate rule's ladder and safety floors, the horizon, and every Stage-0-resolved engine value.
